proposals.title: Climate Change 2022: Mitigation of Climate Change — Chapter 12: Cross-Sectoral Perspectives (Carbon Dioxide Removal)
proposals.container: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report, Working Group III
proposals.why: Authoritative IPCC AR6 chapter establishing CDR as unavoidable for net-zero CO2 and GHG emissions globally.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report
proposals.why: Integrates AR6 findings; states CDR is necessary for net-negative CO2 and counterbalancing residual emissions.

proposals.title: Global Warming of 1.5°C — Special Report (SR15)
proposals.why: Foundational IPCC report projecting 100–1000 GtCO2 CDR needed over 21st century for 1.5°C pathways.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal — 2nd Edition
proposals.why: Most recent global independent scientific assessment of CDR progress, gaps, and scaling needs toward net zero.

proposals.title: The State of Carbon Dioxide Removal — 1st Edition
proposals.why: First comprehensive global CDR assessment; benchmarks current removal (~2 GtCO2/yr) against net-zero scenario needs.

proposals.title: Negative Emissions Technologies and Reliable Sequestration: A Research Agenda
proposals.first_author: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
proposals.why: Consensus US academy report assessing benefits, risks, and sustainable scale potential of all major NETs.

proposals.title: Greenhouse Gas Removal
proposals.first_author: Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.container: Royal Society / Royal Academy of Engineering
proposals.why: UK government-commissioned joint academy report assessing GGR portfolio needed alongside emissions cuts for net zero.

proposals.title: Negative emissions—Part 1: Research landscape and synthesis
proposals.why: Landmark three-part systematic review of the entire NETs literature; clarifies CDR roles, ethics, and scale-up challenges.
